violations.issue: BP_CONCURRENCY repurposed as poll interval sleep — a concurrency setting should not control loop tick rate. Add a dedicated BP_POLL_INTERVAL var or use a fixed value.
wait_for_dependency logs a warning on timeout but main() proceeds to log 'ready' anyway. A dependency that never connected should either raise or prevent the ready signal.
orchestrator package has no __init__.py — all other packages (platform, workflows, sdd) have one. Inconsistent and breaks import bp_agents.orchestrator.
wait_for_dependency and main() have zero test coverage. The orchestrator binary is the entry point and should be tested for connection failure/success paths.
workspaces/ host directory does not exist. Docker auto-creates it as root-owned on first mount, which may cause permission issues for the orchestrator container writing to /data/workspaces.

review_notes: All contracts are importable and tested — 13 tests pass (test_platform_contracts.py, test_sdd_contracts.py)

README documents service URLs, purposes, and quick-start instructions per AC-34 and AC-35
.env.example contains all required variables with placeholder values
No healthcheck on orchestrator, plane, langfuse, or egress-proxy — only postgres has one. OK per AC (running not healthy) but limits observability.
Contract definitions match the spec exactly — no extra fields, no missing fields
Tests are integration-style (public interface), mock-free, and test observable behavior — good adherence to tests.md and mocking.md
